own_full_Latin_analysis.findings: The I,1 fitting/worthiness section includes dignum esse, convenire, decere, mereri and reus sum, with personal-suffix and nominal/infinitival constructions. Separate I,2 weight/weighing is not an automatic favor sense. The derived አደለወ section supplies facere quidam pro natura, placere/probare, satisfacere/obsequi/favere and gratiam habere. Reading both pages does not license moving a derived relation to any spelling of the root.
own_full_Latin_analysis.correction: v1/v2 claimed to distinguish these ranges but did not actually establish the selected form-to-sense link. That explanatory claim was inadequate; it is withdrawn rather than repeated.

own_full_Latin_analysis.findings: Le has dative, relational, direction and governed uses; its presence does not by itself decide English objecthood or the direction of the fit/deserve/favor relation.
Injustice/iniuria/iniquitas sense is supported, but the noun alone supplies neither an actor nor a valency relation to the finite verb.

own_actual_grammar_analysis.findings: Final-weak radicals change or harden in finite formation. A visible w sequence must be analyzed with the weak root; it cannot be declared merely an English object marker.

The causative prefix and personal prefix coalesce in subjunctive/imperfect, and causative vowel formation is separately described. This prevents assuming that an absent standaloneAlf alone settles stem identity. Conversely, the selected Yaman order is not permission to treat the causative sense as already licensed. A full selected paradigm analysis remains necessary.

Verbal suffixes can carry accusative or dative force. The table346 includes masculine singular contracted-o, while348 describes formative-u hardening to-w before contracted third-person vowel suffixes. Thus a plural subject plus singular pronominal suffix is a real analysis to test, but the surface ending alone does not establish the referent or governed le relation.

Weak-root hardening and suffix attachment need to be distinguished from personal formative-u hardening. The singular/plural segmentation and semantic role cannot be proved merely by counting two visible Wawe signs.

tentative_not_certified_parse: A ground-stem fitting/deserving finite with a personal ending and third-person pronominal suffix is a live candidate. Third-person plural plus contracted singular-o is compatible with one suffix pathway in348; it is not certified as the unique segmentation here. Whether the suffix resumes the injustice noun, carries a dative role or participates in another construction remains unestablished by this actor. No English deserves/liable-to/fits-for relation is prescribed.
